args: Activate the '/google-flow-image' skill to perform the scheduled Asian female character asset generation. In workspace d:/ai_projects/ComfyUI, execute the character asset generation pipeline powered by google-flow-image by running: 'cmd /c D:\ai_projects\ComfyUI\venv\Scripts\python.exe tools/hourly_character_task.py --count 1'. Confirm that 9 standalone HD views (with 01_face_portrait as native 9:16 HD primary face) are generated via Google Flow (Imagen 3 / Nano Banana 2.1), face embeddings are extracted from the HD portrait, and the asset is successfully ingested into character_library/index.json.
display_name: Hourly Asian Female Character Generator (Google Flow Image)
description: Every hour at :00 and :30 (Asia/Shanghai), uses the /google-flow-image skill to automatically generate 1 unique Asian female character asset with 9 standalone high-definition views via Google Flow (Imagen 3, with 01_face_portrait as native 9:16 HD primary face), extracts face embeddings, and ingests into character_library and assets.db.
